blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu City Transportation Office (CCTO) has suspended the dry run of its new traffic scheme along Road 15 of Cebu IT Park after the initial implementation resulted in heavier traffic congestion than projected, prompting the restoration of the previous traffic arrangement. The previous traffic flow was reinstated effective 11 p.m. on Friday, November 27, with vehicles exiting Cebu IT Park through Road 15 once again directed toward Gov. Cuenco Avenue. CCTO Assistant Department Head Atty. Kent Jongoy said the suspension was necessary after the test run produced results that differed from the office’s projections, particularly amid […]...
